purpose: Pretrained pilot for effect sizes, variability, utility and attack cost; not a confirmatory security claim

statistics.unit: independent run seed conditional on this fixed article sample
statistics.reason: 3 comparison types x 10 mode/defense/arm groups x 2 split depths; conservative inclusion of baseline self-contrasts

rules: All planned cells retained, including failures
No outcome-based changes to budgets or sample
Engineering preflight outcomes excluded from pilot
No repeated tokens treated as independent seeds
Fixed pretrained-model public head; final victim head not granted
limitations: Training and inference score different document partitions and training-time states; their contrast is descriptive, not causal
Split depth is confounded with host; same GPU type and package versions are checked but not a host crossover
Published attacks are local adaptations, not certified reproductions
Beam search and optimizer steps are not matched compute
Small pilot corpus and five seeds do not establish generalization or equivalence
